note: Wildmoot Bloodhowl Seer (unit identity, Wildmoot): a stooped boar-kin elder with a grey-furred muzzle, clay-glow eyes, an antler crown of two branching tines, a hide robe to the shins with blood handprints, bone and ochre trinkets, a team sash across the chest and a bone wand in the right hand. A totem staff (bone skull and antler top) is strapped diagonally on the back. Tier II: third tines, bone plaques, feather mantle, ochre wand bands; tier III: taller crown, staff skulls, tooth collar, ochre hem. No back flag.
